subject: revit

milestone.title: Doors and windows
milestone.objective: Place all doors and windows from the sketch, with correct swing and sill height, in 20 minutes

sources.title: Revit Help: Doors (fixture)
sources.text: Doors are hosted elements: you can only place a door in a wall. On the Architecture tab, Build panel, click Door (keyboard shortcut DR). Choose a door type in the Type Selector. If the type you need is not in the project, click Load Family on the Modify | Place Door tab and open the Doors folder. Select Tag on Placement to tag each door automatically. While placing the door, press the Spacebar to flip the swing; after placing it, use the flip arrows that appear when the door is selected.

sources.title: Revit Help: Windows (fixture)
sources.text: Windows are also hosted by walls. On the Architecture tab, Build panel, click Window (keyboard shortcut WN). Choose a window type in the Type Selector and click in a wall to place it. Sill Height is an instance parameter: select a window and change Sill Height in the Properties palette to set the distance from the level to the bottom of the window.

lesson_lines: Doors are hosted elements: they live inside a wall.
1. Architecture tab, Build panel: click **Door** (shortcut DR).
2. Choose the door type in the Type Selector. Missing a type? Click **Load Family** on the Modify | Place Door tab and open the Doors folder.
3. Turn on **Tag on Placement** so each door gets a tag.
4. Hover over the wall and press the Spacebar to flip the swing, then click to place.
You can also place doors in empty space first and attach them to a wall later, which is handy while the walls are still changing.

Windows are hosted by walls too. Click **Window** (shortcut WD), pick the type and click in a wall. To set the height, select the window and change **Sill Height** in the Properties palette: it is an instance parameter, so each window can have its own.
Place every door and window from your sketch. Check each door swing against the sketch and set the window sill heights.

planted_errors.quote: You can also place doors in empty space first and attach them to a wall later
planted_errors.correct: Doors can only be placed in a wall (they are hosted elements).
planted_errors.why: The source says doors are hosted and can only be placed in a wall.
The source gives WN as the Window shortcut.
